hero.title: Share and Collaborate
hero.subtitle: Share maps with anyone, anywhere. Collaborate with colleagues to solve problems.

startConversation.title: Share your maps to start a conversation
bullets: Map-based stories communicate insight. They tell stories, share insights, and inspire people to take action.
Instantly share maps to a public, restricted, or private audience.
Present insights in a unified, social media–style feed.
Embed maps in websites or apps; generate secure links.
Publish once; update content for a select group of people.

chooseAudience.title: Choose who sees your maps
bullets: Let just yourself view maps in draft.
Share privately with teams using secure groups in ArcGIS Online.
Make organization-wide sharing available across your company.
Share publicly to the web when you are ready.

collaborate.title: Collaborate to solve more problems
bullets: ArcGIS Online is collaborative at its core. Your maps, ideas, and apps can be used, reworked, and enhanced within your groups.
Use updates and shared work to bring people into the fold—across your community.
Connect with teams using secure groups in ArcGIS Online.
Share knowledge and best practices across your organization.
Build on each other's work to create better solutions together.

quote.text: The beauty of ArcGIS Online is how it pulls together people and departments across the organization, provides instant access to information, and creates time savings. ArcGIS Online opens minds, and people ask for more. It is truly transformative.
quote.author: Christina Kelso
